[[41 ABY|41.5 ABY]], a [[Unidentified planet (Vestara Khai)|planet]]<ref name="Date">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=222689&start=7260#17384444|thread=Books, Comics, & Television VIPs|user=[[Sue Rostoni]]|date=2008-10-02|time=10:48 AM}} dates the beginning of the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series to [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]]. As the main events of ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]'', the second instalment of the series, are dated to 43 ABY by ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'', its events must take place in 43.5 ABY. Therefore, ''Omen''{{'s}} flashbacks to two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before its main events, which take place during the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]'s first [[Lost Tribe of Sith emergence|attacks]] on [[Starship/Legends|ships]] they wished to add to their [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|Sith armada]], must take place around [[41 ABY|41.5 ABY]]. As the short story "[[First Blood (short story)|First Blood]]" depicts one of the aforementioned first attacks by the Lost Tribe of Sith, its events, including First's [[Death/Legends|death]] on a [[Unidentified planet (Vestara Khai)|planet]], must also take place around 41.5 ABY.</ref>

{{Quote|You are not my master. No one is.|First, to Vestara Khai|<ref name="First" />}}
"'''First'''" was the name given to a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] by [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Vestara Khai]]. Once [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] on [[B'nish]], the girl stowed away aboard a [[Damorian Manufacturing Corporation/Legends|Damorian]] [[S18 light freighter]] around [[41 ABY|41.5 ABY]]. However, the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] fell under [[Skirmish near Eriadu|attack]] by the [[Sith Meditation Sphere]] [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]] and was forced to make an emergency landing on a nearby [[Unidentified planet (Vestara Khai)|planet]]. On the surface, the girl encountered [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Vestara Khai]], who [[Death/Legends|killed]] the girl with her [[Parang/Legends|parang]]. When Ship told Khai to name the girl, Khai chose the name "First," as Khai hoped the girl would be the first of many kills.

==Biography==
{{Quote|The pilots were helping me escape from B'nish. I am&mdash;I was&mdash;a slave.|First|<ref name="First" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|girl]] was [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] on [[B'nish]] for some [[Time/Legends|time]], acquiring several scars at a young age. When a [[Damorian Manufacturing Corporation/Legends|Damorian]] [[S18 light freighter]] came to B'nish<ref name="First" /> around [[41 ABY|41.5 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> the girl seized her chance and, with the help of the [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], stowed away aboard the vessel, wearing just a single tattered garment covering her from her shoulders to her knees. After departing the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]], however, the ship fell under [[Skirmish near Eriadu|attack]] by the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] from the planet [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] and their [[Sith Meditation Sphere]], [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]]. The sphere opened fire with its weapons, and the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], heavily damaged, was forced to crash-land on a nearby [[Unidentified planet (Vestara Khai)|planet]] for repairs. In the rough landing, the girl suffered a wound on her head and was knocked unconscious.<ref name="First" />

[[File:Vestara_First.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Vestara Khai stands over the corpse of First]]
When she awoke, she encountered [[Vestara Khai]], an [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] of the Lost Tribe. The girl, seeing an activated [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] in the apprentice's hand, begged for her life, and offered Khai the cargo aboard the ship, promising that nobody would ever know if Khai allowed her to escape, as her name was not on any crew roster. Khai, however, told the girl that she would have to [[Death/Legends|kill]] her and offered her a painless death if the girl knelt in cooperation. The girl broke into tears and declared that her life was her own, and that she was no longer anybody's servant. She attempted to escape, but Khai threw her [[Glass/Legends|glass]] [[Parang/Legends|parang]] at the fleeing girl, killing her instantly. Khai was caught off-guard by how much [[Blood/Legends|blood]] flowed from the girl, and the sensation in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] of her life leaving her body shocked Khai so much that she began to panic and fell to her knees. After Khai, still reeling and trembling, stood and approached the girl while wondering what her name might have been, Ship told Khai to name the girl herself. After a moment's thought, Khai named the girl "First," as she was the first of many whose lives the Sith apprentice hoped to take.<ref name="First" />

In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="AlliesDate">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> when Vestara Khai's father [[Gavar Khai]] told her that she should not suppress her feelings for the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Ben Skywalker]] and instead cultivate them in hopes of manipulating Skywalker, Vestara realized she had not been as caught off guard as she was in that moment since she had killed<ref name="FotJA">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]''</ref> First,<ref name="First" /> recalling how surprisingly difficult killing had been and how someone dying at a close range felt.<ref name="FotJA" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I just&hellip;I just want to be&hellip;to live as a free being.|First, to Vestara Khai|<ref name="First" />}}
The [[Color/Legends|blue]]-[[Eye/Legends|eyed]] and pale-skinned girl "First" had an affection for life, despite spending much of hers in slavery. She longed to live a life of her choosing in which she would not be subject to the orders of others. When the Sith Vestara Khai threatened the girl with her lightsaber, First offered Khai the cargo from the freighter and begged the Sith to spare her life. While frightened to the point of tears by the knowledge that she was about to die, First showed the strength and resolve to live her last moments as a free being, refusing to kneel when instructed to do so. Instead, the girl ran, and while Khai killed her, she sensed a passion for life in the girl that Khai had never before encountered, which, along with the disturbance her death triggered in the Force, was enough to stop the Sith's breath.<ref name="First" />

==Skills and abilities==
First could run as quickly as a [[sorumi]] doe, but was not fast enough to flee Khai before the Sith threw her parami and killed her.<ref name="First" />

==Equipment==
First wore only a single garment that covered her from her shoulders to her knees.<ref name="First" />

==Behind the scenes==
First was first mentioned, albeit indirectly, in [[Christie Golden]]'s [[2010]] novel, ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]'', the fifth novel in the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series.<ref name="FotJA">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]''</ref> She later appeared and was identified in Golden's short story "[[First Blood (short story)|First Blood]]," which was published in the [[Star Wars Insider 125|125th issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine. The short story, illustrated by [[Brian Rood]]<ref name="First" /> and published on [[April 26]], [[2011]],<ref name="Insider Date">{{GameSpot|subdomain=comicvine|url=star-wars-insider-125/4000-445530|text=Star Wars Insider #125}}</ref> contains an image depicting Khai standing over First's corpse.<ref name="First" />
